profiles.description: Actual/360 money market basis: count the actual elapsed calendar days and divide by a fixed 360-day year.
Actual/365 fixed basis: count real elapsed calendar days over a constant 365-day year, even in leap years.
European 30E/360 basis: twelve 30-day months, replace either date day 31 with 30. No special February month-end rule.
Actual/360 money market basis: count the actual elapsed calendar days and divide by a fixed 360-day year.
